description: A past-tense date ('Last year you returned your form by 03/01/2025.') describes history, not a deadline — no 'Respond by' may be invented.

input.text:
CEDAR COUNTY BENEFITS
It is time to renew your benefits.
The benefits you need to renew have a check-mark next to them:
[x] SNAP
Due dates:
Last year you returned your form by 03/01/2025.
Items we need from you: send copies.
• Proof of income: last 4 pay stubs.
